original: 本屋に行って、店員さんに「自己啓発書ってどこですか？」って聞いたら、「教えたら意味ないですよ」って言われた。

en.text: I went to a bookstore and asked the saleswoman, "Where's the self-help section?" She said if she told me, it would defeat the purpose.

original: 書け。

en.text: Write.

original: こまかい字で書きやがって。

en.text: The characters are written so small!
